subject: MAP checkpoint: Security & compliance asks — rollup, owners, and risk readout
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@fastpay.com>; security@fastpay.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint: Security & compliance asks — initial rollup

Hi Maria / FastPay security team,

Thanks for taking the time to partner on the MAP. Building on last week's discovery, attached is a concise rollup (Initial_MAP_Security_Timeline.xlsx) that lists the outstanding security/compliance asks we flagged: SOC 2 evidence, DPA redlines, audit log retention, and pen test scheduling.

For this weekly checkpoint I'd like to collect:
- Owner for each ask at FastPay (name + email)
- Target date to deliver artifacts or complete the step
- Any known blockers or third-party dependencies (e.g., pen test vendor scheduling)

Quick asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm who will own the SOC 2 artifact collection?
2) Are there contractual DPA clauses you expect to adjust before procurement?
3) Do we have a preferred window for the pen test (we can coordinate with John Evans at Consult-Pen)?

Planning to collate responses and send a short exec readout for your leadership on Monday. If it's easier, we can take 20 minutes tomorrow to walk through owners.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Initial_MAP_Security_Timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@fastpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fastpay.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: Security & compliance asks — initial rollup

Kimberly —

Thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. Quick replies inline below and I attached our pen test window proposal (FP_pen_test_schedule.pdf).

- SOC 2 artifact owner: Diego Ramos (diego.ramos@fastpay.com) — he'll own the evidence pull and we can use a shared Drive folder.
- DPA: Procurement flagged three clauses for negotiation (data residency, subprocessors, and liability cap). Legal will propose redlines; I expect a first pass by 2027-09-27.
- Audit logs: Our infra team retains 90 days by default; we can extend to 12 months but will need a cost estimate.
- Pen test: Consult-Pen (John Evans) proposed the week of Oct 18–22; provisional hold is okay but final depends on vendor capacity.

Blockers: Diego is heading onsite Oct 4–8, so artifact pull may be shifted if we coordinate around that. Procurement will need the DPA redline draft before review cycles start.

I'll add Diego to the thread once he confirms.

—Maria
Head of Information Security, FastPay

Attachment: FP_pen_test_schedule.pdf (proposal)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@fastpay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: Security & compliance asks — initial rollup

Maria — really helpful, thanks. A couple of clarifications to make the MAP readout actionable for both sides:

1) SOC 2 artifact collection: If Diego confirms, we'll create a scoped artifact checklist (SOC2_artifact_list_v1.xlsx) and share a Drive link. We can handle the collection format (CSV vs ZIP) — Diego, what's easiest?
2) DPA redlines: good to know procurement will propose redlines by 9/27. Can you confirm the procurement contact so we can set a short SLA for turnaround on our standard redline response?
3) Audit logs: Aditya, can you estimate projected cost and storage impact for extending retention to 12 months?
4) Pen test window: we can tentatively reserve Oct 18–22 on our side; John Evans, can you confirm availability?

I'll draft an exec one-pager after we have owners and dates; planning to share with FastPay leadership on 9/21.

Thanks all —
Kim

Attachment: SOC2_artifact_list_v1.xlsx (artifact checklist)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: Security & compliance asks — initial rollup

Kim / team —

Quick cost note on audit log retention: increasing from 90 days to 12 months for the expected telemetry volume in FastPay's profile is ~+$1,800/month on our managed log tier (rough estimate; dependent on compression and indexing). We can provide a more precise quote after a 7-day sample export.

Also, Diego — if FastPay can export logs in compressed JSON/NDJSON we can ingest them directly into the artifact bundle; otherwise we'll coordinate a pull.

I've uploaded a short preview of the retention estimate and a sample ingestion checklist to our shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/FP/log-retention-preview

-Aditya
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@fastpay.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@fastpay.com>, security@fastpay.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, John Evans <john.evans@consult-pen.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP: Week 2 readout & action owners (exec summary)

Team — thanks for the updates. Below is the concise weekly readout and action list I'll be sharing with execs at FastPay and internally at Redwood. Please flag any inaccuracies by EOD Wed 9/22.

Executive readout (one paragraph):
FastPay and Redwood continue to make steady progress on MAP security items. SOC 2 artifact ownership and DPA redline timing were confirmed; pen test scheduling is tentatively set for Oct 18–22 pending vendor confirmation. Audit log retention extension requires a cost decision from FastPay. Action owners and dates below.

Action items (owner — target — note):
- Diego Ramos (FastPay) — 2027-09-27 — Confirm and begin SOC 2 artifact export into shared Drive; use SOC2_artifact_list_v1.xlsx checklist.
- FastPay Procurement (Maria Lopex / TBC) — 2027-09-27 — Share DPA redline draft; Redwood to respond within 3 business days.
- Aditya Rao (Redwood) — 2027-09-22 — Provide formal cost estimate & 7-day sampling plan for 12-month audit log retention.
- John Evans (Consult-Pen) — 2027-09-30 — Confirm availability for pen test week Oct 18–22 and provide engagement SOA.
- Kimberly Park (Redwood) — 2027-09-21 — Share exec one-pager and DocuSign pre-req (if procurement needs an NDA amendment).

Risks / blockers:
- Procurement review cycles could push DPA finalization into October.
- Diego's onsite week (Oct 4–8) may delay evidence pulls if not planned around.

Next steps:
- Maria to introduce Diego to this thread and confirm artifact export format.
- John to confirm pen test availability or propose alternatives.
- Aditya to send the retention sample plan by 9/22.

DocuSign link for procurement-ready docs (draft NDA/engagement terms): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=AB12CD34

Thanks — I will circulate the formatted one-pager to execs after EOD 9/22 if there are no changes.

Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pen_test_report_summary.docx (placeholder), SOC2_artifact_list_v1.xlsx, Initial_MAP_Security_Timeline.xlsx
